card.who: Philip Danby, 33, a teacher at the comprehensive, which stands closed for the game's window. Walks the Hook every day because he does not know what else to do with a morning.
card.speak: Mild, wry, too many words, apologises for them.
card.life: Rents 29 Chapel Lane. Walks the quay at ten and the allotments after dinner.
card.rivals: Knows none of them and says so.
